eps.ov: Lorna goes on an adventure with her skill, the Internet, which grants her access to near infinite knowledge.
Lorna arrives in Aiphoné and goes to register with the adventurer's guild.

eps.t: I Tried Looking At Message Boards!
eps.ov: Lorna must overcome a dungeon considered impossible to complete if she wants to pass the exam.
Lorna unexpectedly saves an elf and is taken to the hidden elven village plagued by a strange disease.

eps.t: I Tried Quitting Being a Savior!
eps.ov: While the elves celebrate the end of the plague, Lorna feels guilty about being revered as their Savior.
Lorna visits the port town of Aquas and discovers why the townsfolk are terrified of Wednesdays.

eps.t: I Tried Making a Secret Weapon!
eps.ov: Lorna helps Aries complete the weekly Wednesday mission.
Lorna uses her new Fast Travel skill to return to Aiphoné, which is under attack from a powerful demon.
